# Find the lost: All spawn locations with map

Since the map expansion in Patch 52 and the new Skyline Valley area, there have also been additional enemies: The Lost.

There are often challenges in which you have to kill or photograph those who have been lost. When it comes to photos, it doesn't matter whether the lost people are alive or dead. Of course, for the “kill” challenge you need them alive. Here you will find some places and events where you can meet lost people. You will also find a map with spawn points listed according to spawn chances below.

## Places with lost people

- Dark Hollow Manor (100%)
- Shining Creek Cavern (100%)
- Slumber Mill Motel (100%)
- West of Camp Rapidan (100%)

You can find further distributed spawn points on the map.

## Events with lost people

- Dangerous pastime
- Neurological warfare (few spawns)

## Map with Lost Spawns in Skyline Valley

Source for spawn locations: Mappalachia
